entities.name: Ahmad ibn Arabshah

entities.summary: Abu Muhammad Shihab al-Din Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim also known as Muhammad ibn Arabshah, was an Arab writer and traveller who lived under the reign of Timur (1370–1405).
